text.ja: ALE：実際の移動セル上の解析積分と時間参照 x(xi,t)=xi+.2*sin(2*pi*xi)*sin(2*pi*t)/(2*pi); m_i=integral_[x_i,x_(i+1)](1+.2*sin(2*pi*(x-.7*t)))dx. 周期[0,1]、速度.7、q0=1+.2sin(2pi x)、面速度w=.2sin(2pi xi)cos(2pi t)、N40/80/160、T1。時間比較N40,T.25,32/64/128step。解析解q(x,t)=1+.2sin[2π(x−.7t)]を、主計算が保存した実際の面位置の間で積分します。解析面位置との幾何誤差を別記し、時間検査は同じFV ODEを二公差の独立DOP853で解きます。
text.en: ALE: analytic moving-cell integrals and separate time reference x(xi,t)=xi+.2*sin(2*pi*xi)*sin(2*pi*t)/(2*pi); m_i=integral_[x_i,x_(i+1)](1+.2*sin(2*pi*(x-.7*t)))dx. Periodic unit interval, speed.7,q0=1+.2sin(2pi x), grid speed .2sin(2pi xi)cos(2pi t),N40/80/160,T1. Separate N40,T.25 time series32/64/128steps. Integrate q(x,t)=1+.2sin[2pi(x-.7t)] between the actual saved primary faces. Separately record geometry error against analytic face positions. Time checks use independent DOP853 at two tolerances for the same FV ODE.
